SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-16-2026 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-16-2026 BY VISITING JUDGE CARRIE ZEPEDA. PLAINTIFF SARAH LEWIS IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM VIDEO CONFERENCE. DEFENDANT ENA ROSARIO REALES IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LUIS ERNAN MAGALLON IS PRESENT. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CARRIE ZEPEDA; CLERK: N.WEBB. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LEWIS, SARAH IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT REALES, ENA ROSARIO MAGALLON, LUIS ERNAN FOR ANY BACK RENT, UTILITIES OR DAMAGES FROM OCTOBER 2025 TO JUNE 2026.
